data.name: SunWars
data.detailed_description:
Sun Wars – Minimalist strategy. Every decision matters.

After 500,000+ downloads on Google Play, SunWars arrives on Steam!

SunWars is a streamlined real-time strategy game built around a simple idea: generate energy, expand your solar system and destroy your opponent before they destroy you.

There are no complicated tech trees or dozens of unit types to manage. Instead, victory comes from timing, positioning and making the right decision at the right moment.

Your suns continuously generate energy. Use it to strengthen your position, create new suns or launch attacks against enemy systems.

But every destroyed sun becomes a black hole, permanently changing the battlefield and forcing you to adapt your strategy!

Simple Rules, Strategic Decisions

SunWars is easy to understand, but every battle presents a different tactical problem.

Decide when to save energy, when to expand and when to attack.

A poorly timed offensive can leave your system defenseless. Waiting too long can allow your opponent to become unstoppable.

There is no random combat system deciding the outcome for you: your choices determine whether you win or lose.

Black Holes Change Everything

Destroying an enemy sun doesn't simply remove it from the battlefield.

It creates a black hole.

Black holes permanently affect the surrounding space, turning every destroyed sun into a strategic decision and changing how the battle develops.

Sometimes destroying a sun immediately is the right move.

Sometimes keeping it alive can be even more important.

80+ Handcrafted Battles

Fight your way through more than 80 handcrafted constellations, each offering a different battlefield layout and tactical challenge.

As you progress, new situations and cosmic hazards force you to rethink strategies that worked before.

Designed for Short, Focused Strategy Sessions

SunWars is designed around compact strategic battles rather than long RTS matches.

Jump into a battle, test a strategy, improve your approach and try again.

Whether you play for a few minutes or work your way through the entire campaign, the focus is always on clear rules and meaningful decisions.

Key Features

  • Minimalist real-time strategy focused on timing and decision-making

  • 80+ handcrafted constellations to conquer

  • Energy-based gameplay with simple rules and tactical depth

  • Black holes that permanently transform the battlefield

  • No complex unit management or tech trees

  • Short, focused battles designed to be replayed and mastered

  • No luck-based combat — your decisions determine the outcome

  • Easy to learn, increasingly challenging to master

From Mobile to PC

Originally released on mobile and played by hundreds of thousands of players, SunWars now comes to PC with the same accessible strategy gameplay at its core.

If you enjoy minimalist strategy games where a few simple rules create difficult decisions, SunWars was made for you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (GTX 750 / RX 560 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
